sources: import { catalog } from "@workspace/domain"; export const key = (name, input) => [name, input];

class Registry { publicOutput(name, output) { const operation = this.operations.get(name); return operation ? operation.publicResult.parse(output) : output; } publishResult(name,result) { if (!this.operations.has(name)) return result; return { ...result, output: this.publicOutput(name,result.output), reversal: result.reversal ? {command: result.reversal.command,input:{}} : null }; } }
const bound = { read: async (input, actor) => operation.publicResult.parse(await binding.execute(input, actor)) };
